info.title: OpenAgents API
info.description: Every route under /api/v1, plus checkout, the billing portal, the Stripe and GitHub webhooks, Connect onboarding, and the internal cron routes. Some paths describe target contracts landing alongside this document across several batches — batch 2 (tokens, versions, lifecycle/moderation, reviews, analytics, search facets, tags), batch 3 (subscriptions, collections, binary files, GitHub auto-sync, durable rate limits, account export/delete, badges/OG/RSS), and batch 4 (organizations, content scanning and security advisories, version diffs and changelog, refunds, seller validation, cron-driven download rollups and analytics) — see docs/AUDIT-2026-09.md and src/content/docs/api.md for narrative docs and current status. All responses are JSON except tarball/raw-file/badge/OG-image downloads. Every non-2xx response is shaped like Error unless noted otherwise.

bearerToken.description: Personal access token, `Authorization: Bearer oa_<40 hex>`. Scopes: read, publish, star, download, review. A route that accepts a token also accepts a browser session cookie, which is treated as having every scope.

sessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
sessionCookie.description: Auth.js v5 session cookie, set after sign-in at /signin. Unrestricted — behaves as every token scope at once.

cronSecret.description: Bearer token matching the deployment's CRON_SECRET env var, used only by the internal /api/cron/* routes. Not a user credential — never accepted on any other route.

slug.name: slug
slug.description: A collection's slug, unique per owner.

userHandle.name: userHandle
userHandle.description: A user handle, e.g. an organization member being removed.

issues.description: Present only alongside validation failures (e.g. publish).

amountCents.description: For subscription, the amount charged per interval.

interval.description: Required when model is subscription; absent/ignored otherwise.

Manifest.description: Parsed openagent.yaml, camelCase (source manifest keys are snake_case). See src/content/docs/package-format.md.

requires.description: "owner/name@range" dependencies. Resolved (with transitive requires, cycle/conflict reporting) by CLI 0.3.0's `add`; not auto-installed server-side.

ownerType.description: Whether `owner` names a user handle or an organization handle.

verifiedSource.description: Set once a linked GitHub source has synced at least once.

correctedQuery.description: Present when `q` was typo-corrected before matching.

prefix.description: First 8 characters of the token, for telling tokens apart in the UI.

token.description: Plaintext token, `oa_` + 40 hex. Shown exactly once.

histogram.description: Count of reviews at each star rating, independent of sort/limit/offset.

package.description: Inlined so a client can render the collection without a request per item.

itemCount.description: Present on list responses; omitted in favor of a full `items` array on the single-collection GET.

ref.description: Branch or tag; null means the repo's default branch / the pushed tag.

secret.description: Shown exactly once, on the PUT response that creates the link. Never returned by GET.

lastResult.description: e.g. "published 1.3.0", "up to date", or an error message from the last sync attempt.

Badge.description: Query parameters accepted by GET .../badge. The response itself is an image/svg+xml body, not JSON.

AccountExport.description: Everything tied to the signed-in account. The response itself is a JSON file download (Content-Disposition: attachment), not an inline API shape a client is expected to type against.

url.description: Stripe-hosted billing portal session URL; redirect the subscriber here.

affectedVersions.description: Semver range, e.g. "<1.3.0"; null means all versions.

scanFlags.description: Count of publishes flagged per rule id, over the window.

post.summary: Stripe webhook receiver
post.description: Called by Stripe, verified against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Not intended for direct client calls. Handles checkout.session.completed/async_payment_succeeded/async_payment_failed, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created/closed, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, the Accounts v2 recipient-configuration events, and the legacy account.updated fallback.

post.summary: GitHub release/tag-push receiver for one linked package source
post.description: Verified against the source's per-link secret (HMAC over the raw body, compared to X-Hub-Signature-256), falling back to SOURCE_WEBHOOK_KEY/AUTH_SECRET for the outer request. Imports the manifest at the released/tagged ref and publishes a new version only when its version is strictly greater than the currently published one. Not intended for direct client calls.
